description:
About our brand and products

COLAMY is a modern direct-to-consumer furniture brand founded in 2019. We started with ergonomic seating and have expanded into thoughtfully designed furniture for the home, including ergonomic office chairs, dining chairs, standing desks, recliners, and storage solutions. Our products combine modern design, everyday comfort, premium materials, and excellent value, helping customers create comfortable and functional living spaces. We also offer free shipping, responsive customer support, and fast fulfillment through multiple overseas warehouses.

What makes us different

  • Modern, comfort-first furniture designed for everyday living.
  • Expertise in ergonomic seating with expanded collections for the entire home.
  • Premium quality at accessible prices through our direct-to-consumer model.
  • Fast shipping from multiple overseas warehouses.
  • Strong customer satisfaction with products known for easy assembly, durability, and thoughtful design.

How affiliates can earn

Affiliates earn commissions on every qualified purchase made through their referral links during the attribution window. We welcome content creators, review websites, bloggers, interior design publishers, home office experts, and deal communities to join our program. High-quality partners may also receive exclusive promotions, product collaborations, and seasonal campaign opportunities.

How to promote us

Partners can promote COLAMY through:

  • Product reviews and comparison articles
  • Home office and ergonomic chair recommendations
  • Interior design and home décor content
  • Social media posts, short videos, and lifestyle content
  • Buying guides and gift guides
  • Email newsletters and deal roundups

Please use official COLAMY branding, product images, and marketing materials, and avoid misleading claims or unauthorized discounts.

Other information

  • Founded in 2019.
  • Over 500,000 chairs sold worldwide.
  • Fulfillment supported by multiple overseas warehouses for faster delivery.
  • Dedicated customer support team.
  • Most products include a 1-year warranty, while the ATLAS ergonomic chair is backed by a 3-year warranty.
